item.title: From GPT to agents: how AI changed on Hacker News
item.description:
This week I revived my Hacker News dataset. It is every story and comment from 2007 until this week, about 50 million rows, as monthly Parquet files that DuckDB can query directly. Having it fresh again, I wanted to ask one simple question.

How did the conversation about AI actually change?

Not “is AI big”, that one is obvious. I mean what people talk about, who they talk about, and how they feel about it. Hacker News is a decent microscope for this. It is a developer crowd, it is very online, and it reacts to everything within hours.
